services.name: Tuckpointing
services.blurb: Worn joints ground or raked out and refilled with mortar soft enough for St. Louis red brick.

services.name: Parapet & cornice repair
services.blurb: Flat-roof parapets and corbelled brick cornices rebuilt before loose brick reaches the sidewalk.

services.name: Chimney repair
services.blurb: Chimney tops relaid, crowns rebuilt and joints repointed so the chimney stops shedding brick.

services.name: Soft brick replacement
services.blurb: Spalled soft salmon brick swapped for salvaged brick from the same era and color.

services.name: Foundation tuckpointing
services.blurb: Stone and brick foundation joints repointed to keep water and critters out of the basement.

services.name: Arches & lintels
services.blurb: Jack arches and segmental arches over doors and windows reset when the brick starts to drop.

services.name: Front stoops
services.blurb: Brick and stone stoops rebuilt on a solid base and laid back level with the door.

services.name: Garden walls & patios
services.blurb: Brick garden walls and patios laid from reclaimed city brick, matched to the house.

services.name: Fire pits
services.blurb: A brick or stone fire pit built on a gravel base, lined with fire brick inside.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our Soulard house is 1880s soft brick and the back wall was crumbling at the joints. Gus explained why hard mortar ruins it and used a softer mix. The color match is close.
reviews.name: Jenna C.

reviews.text: A brick fell off our parapet onto the front walk. They rebuilt the top courses and the corbelled cornice the same week we called. Nobody on the block can tell.
reviews.name: Ron D.

reviews.text: We had about forty spalled bricks on the south side. They found salvaged brick that matched and swapped them out one at a time.
reviews.name: Priya N.

reviews.text: Basement was getting damp along the old stone foundation. They raked and repointed every joint on the outside. Much drier this spring.
reviews.name: Mark H.

reviews.text: The arch over our front door had a crack running through it and a brick sliding out. They shored it up, relaid the arch and you would never know.
reviews.name: Carol F.

reviews.text: Built a patio and a fire pit from old city brick to match the house. They laid out the pattern with us on site before starting.
reviews.name: Steve W.

proof.guarantee: If new mortar cracks or comes loose within two years, we come back and fix it at no charge.
